## Pilot scope

Riverside and Elm Park clinics, 60 clinicians, from August 17, 2026. Expansion to other clinics needs a CSCAB decision and a clinical safety review based on the pilot data.

## Pilot measures

- Note completion within 24 hours of the visit (baseline 71%).
- Time clinicians spend on documentation after hours.
- Note accuracy audit: 30 notes per clinician in the first two months, reviewed by Clinical Informatics.

## Notes

- Patients can decline at any time; the clinician turns off recording in the Quillon app and documents manually.
- Quillon is listed on the approved AI tools page. Other AI scribes are **not** approved, even for trials.
